versions.changelog:
Security
- API keys are now limited to reading your plan and recording training.
  They can no longer create or revoke keys, change account details, delete
  anything, generate plans, spend credits or reach billing.
- Keys stop working when their account is deleted.
- Removed API-key management endpoints from the bundled API reference.
- The key is passed to curl on stdin, so it no longer shows in the process list.
- HYBRID_API_URL must be https; plan ids, dates and log bodies are validated
  before any request is sent.
- Read-only and write commands are now listed separately, and every write is
  marked as a change to your live account. The agent must say what will
  change and get your OK before writing.
- Narrower activation: only for your Hybrid Training Plan account, not
  general fitness questions.
- Declares allowed-tools so the skill can run only its own script.

New
- `today` and `upcoming`: your sessions with ids, work sets, suggested
  weights and run steps, ready to log against.
- Logging guide for timed holds, carries, rows and circuit rounds.

Fixed
- `set-max` works again (the endpoint moved to PUT with `exerciseName`).
- `dashboard` returns a short summary instead of the whole plan and your email.
- Errors now show the server's message, and requests time out after 30s.
- API reference updated to the current endpoints and fields.

- Added metadata for environment and dependency requirements to improve compatibility visibility.
- No other functional or documentation changes.
Initial release. Supports viewing today's workout, logging strength sets and runs, marking days complete/skip, and managing exercise 1RMs.
